quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The manager said to Diego, "Submit the report by Friday."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager told Diego to submit the report by Friday.
quests.ruleExplanation: The imperative 'Submit...' becomes the infinitive structure 'to submit', following the pattern 'told someone to do something'.
quests.nativeTip: Commands become 'told + person + to + base verb' in reported speech.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said to Diego, "Submit the report by Friday."" ➔ "The manager told Diego to submit the report by Friday."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The coach said to the players, "Warm up before the match."
quests.reportedSpeech: The coach told the players to warm up before the match.
quests.ruleExplanation: The command 'Warm up...' becomes the infinitive 'to warm up' after 'told the players'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the infinitive form 'to warm up' — don't just copy the base verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coach said to the players, "Warm up before the match."" ➔ "The coach told the players to warm up before the match."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The pilot said to the passengers, "Fasten your seatbelts."
quests.reportedSpeech: The pilot told the passengers to fasten their seatbelts.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Your' becomes 'their' to match 'the passengers', and the imperative becomes 'to fasten'.
quests.nativeTip: Don't forget the possessive pronoun also needs to match the object.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The pilot said to the passengers, "Fasten your seatbelts."" ➔ "The pilot told the passengers to fasten their seatbelts."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Request
quests.directSpeech: Elena said to her assistant, "Please send the invoice today."
quests.reportedSpeech: Elena asked her assistant to send the invoice that day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Please' signals a polite request, so 'asked' is used, and 'today' becomes 'that day'.
quests.nativeTip: Polite requests with 'please' use 'asked' instead of 'told'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Elena said to her assistant, "Please send the invoice today."" ➔ "Elena asked her assistant to send the invoice that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Request
quests.directSpeech: The librarian said to the visitors, "Please keep your voices down."
quests.reportedSpeech: The librarian asked the visitors to keep their voices down.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Please' marks this as a polite request, and 'your' becomes 'their'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Please' marks this as a polite request rather than a plain command.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The librarian said to the visitors, "Please keep your voices down."" ➔ "The librarian asked the visitors to keep their voices down."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Request
quests.directSpeech: The customer said to the waiter, "Could you bring the bill, please?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The customer asked the waiter to bring the bill.
quests.ruleExplanation: The polite question 'Could you...?' becomes the infinitive structure 'asked the waiter to bring'.
quests.nativeTip: Polite questions with 'could you...' also become 'asked + object + to'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The customer said to the waiter, "Could you bring the bill, please?"" ➔ "The customer asked the waiter to bring the bill."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The officer said to the driver, "Pull over immediately!"
quests.reportedSpeech: The officer ordered the driver to pull over immediately.
quests.ruleExplanation: The forceful command becomes 'ordered the driver to pull over', reflecting the authority in the original tone.
quests.nativeTip: A strong, authoritative command is best reported with 'ordered', not 'asked'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The officer said to the driver, "Pull over immediately!"" ➔ "The officer ordered the driver to pull over immediately."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The general said to the troops, "Hold your positions!"
quests.reportedSpeech: The general ordered the troops to hold their positions.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Your' becomes 'their', and the command becomes 'to hold'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the infinitive form and match the possessive to the object.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The general said to the troops, "Hold your positions!"" ➔ "The general ordered the troops to hold their positions."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The judge said to the defendant, "Answer the question."
quests.reportedSpeech: The judge ordered the defendant to answer the question.
quests.ruleExplanation: The judge's authority makes 'ordered' the appropriate reporting verb, with the infinitive 'to answer'.
quests.nativeTip: A judge's command in court is forceful enough to use 'ordered' rather than a softer verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The judge said to the defendant, "Answer the question."" ➔ "The judge ordered the defendant to answer the question."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Warning
quests.directSpeech: The lifeguard said to the swimmers, "Don't swim past the flags."
quests.reportedSpeech: The lifeguard warned the swimmers not to swim past the flags.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't swim' becomes 'not to swim' after 'warned', keeping 'not' immediately before 'to'.
quests.nativeTip: Negative commands use 'not to' directly before the verb, not 'to not'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The lifeguard said to the swimmers, "Don't swim past the flags."" ➔ "The lifeguard warned the swimmers not to swim past the flags."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Warning
quests.directSpeech: The electrician said to the homeowner, "Don't touch the wires."
quests.reportedSpeech: The electrician warned the homeowner not to touch the wires.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't touch' becomes 'not to touch'; losing 'not' would reverse the meaning entirely.
quests.nativeTip: Make sure the negative meaning survives the transformation.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The electrician said to the homeowner, "Don't touch the wires."" ➔ "The electrician warned the homeowner not to touch the wires."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Warning
quests.directSpeech: The sign said, "Do not feed the animals."
quests.reportedSpeech: The sign warned visitors not to feed the animals.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Do not feed' becomes 'not to feed', following the standard negative-infinitive pattern.
quests.nativeTip: Keep 'not' directly before 'to', and don't forget the infinitive base verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The sign said, "Do not feed the animals."" ➔ "The sign warned visitors not to feed the animals."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: Grace said to her brother, "Remember to lock the door."
quests.reportedSpeech: Grace reminded her brother to lock the door.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Remember to lock' becomes 'reminded...to lock', a natural match for this kind of instruction.
quests.nativeTip: 'Remember to...' as an instruction is naturally reported with 'reminded'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Grace said to her brother, "Remember to lock the door."" ➔ "Grace reminded her brother to lock the door."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: The dentist said to the patient, "Don't forget to floss every day."
quests.reportedSpeech: The dentist reminded the patient to floss every day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't forget to floss' becomes 'reminded...to floss', since both phrases mean the same thing.
quests.nativeTip: 'Don't forget to...' means the same as 'remember to...', so it's reported the same way.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The dentist said to the patient, "Don't forget to floss every day."" ➔ "The dentist reminded the patient to floss every day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher said to the class, "Remember to bring your textbooks tomorrow."
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher reminded the class to bring their textbooks the next day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Remember to bring' becomes 'reminded...to bring', 'your' becomes 'their', and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'.
quests.nativeTip: Three changes at once: the reporting verb pattern, the possessive, and the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher said to the class, "Remember to bring your textbooks tomorrow."" ➔ "The teacher reminded the class to bring their textbooks the next day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: The doctor said to the patient, "You should drink more water."
quests.reportedSpeech: The doctor advised the patient to drink more water.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'You should drink' becomes the infinitive structure 'advised the patient to drink'.
quests.nativeTip: 'You should...' as advice is reported with 'advised...to'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The doctor said to the patient, "You should drink more water."" ➔ "The doctor advised the patient to drink more water."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern

quests.reportedSpeech: The financial advisor advised the couple to save more each month.

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The financial advisor said to the couple, "You should save more each month."" ➔ "The financial advisor advised the couple to save more each month."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reporting Verb Pattern
quests.directSpeech: The trainer said to Marcus, "You shouldn't skip breakfast."
quests.reportedSpeech: The trainer advised Marcus not to skip breakfast.

quests.nativeTip: Negative advice follows the same 'not to' pattern as negative commands.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The trainer said to Marcus, "You shouldn't skip breakfast."" ➔ "The trainer advised Marcus not to skip breakfast."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command

quests.reportedSpeech: The manager told the staff not to use their phones during meetings.

quests.nativeTip: Keep 'not' immediately before 'to', and update the possessive to match the group.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said to the staff, "Don't use your phones during meetings."" ➔ "The manager told the staff not to use their phones during meetings."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Request

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima said to her son, "Please don't stay up too late."" ➔ "Fatima asked her son not to stay up too late."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Warning
quests.directSpeech: The sign at the pool said, "Do not run near the water."
quests.reportedSpeech: The lifeguard warned everyone not to run near the water.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Do not run' becomes 'not to run' after 'warned', preserving the safety meaning.
quests.nativeTip: A safety notice like this is best reported with 'warned', keeping the negative infinitive intact.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The sign at the pool said, "Do not run near the water."" ➔ "The lifeguard warned everyone not to run near the water."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command
quests.directSpeech: The technician said to the customer, "Restart the router if it stops working."
quests.reportedSpeech: The technician told the customer to restart the router if it stopped working.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Restart...if it stops' becomes the infinitive 'to restart...if it stopped', reported with 'told' since it's an instruction, not a danger warning.
quests.nativeTip: This is neutral guidance, not a warning about danger — 'told' fits better than 'warned'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The technician said to the customer, "Restart the router if it stops working."" ➔ "The technician told the customer to restart the router if it stopped working."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Command

quests.reportedSpeech: The safety officer told the workers to wear their helmets at all times.
quests.ruleExplanation: The positive command 'Wear...' becomes 'to wear', and 'your' becomes 'their'.
quests.nativeTip: This is a positive instruction, not a negative warning — check the meaning carefully before choosing 'not to'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The safety officer said to the workers, "Wear your helmets at all times."" ➔ "The safety officer told the workers to wear their helmets at all times."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Warning
quests.directSpeech: The nurse said to the visitors, "Please don't touch the equipment."
quests.reportedSpeech: The nurse warned the visitors not to touch the equipment.
quests.ruleExplanation: Given the safety context, 'warned' is more suitable, and 'don't touch' becomes 'not to touch'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Please don't...' about hospital equipment is closer to a safety warning than a simple request — and don't drop 'not'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The nurse said to the visitors, "Please don't touch the equipment."" ➔ "The nurse warned the visitors not to touch the equipment."

quests.nativeTip: Update the demonstrative and the time word inside the infinitive clause.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said to Layla, "Finish this by tomorrow."" ➔ "The manager told Layla to finish that by the next day."

quests.nativeTip: Both the place word and the time word change inside this command.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coach said to the team, "Meet here at 6 a.m. tomorrow."" ➔ "The coach told the team to meet there at 6 a.m. the next day."
